purpose: Expose a complete coursework pipeline with speckle filtering, angle correction and adaptive thresholding while preserving the original unconstrained comparisons and primary role.
introduced_after: Candidate screening and partial model-validation scores were observed. No Cantarell test detection scores have been computed.
reason: The original gamma0-plus-Niblack primary constraint permits the no-filter control. A separate required-filter role makes the mandatory filtering operation executable without falsely calling it the overall validation winner.
training_changes: None. Use only already frozen, retained candidate configurations and the original seven trained classifier configurations; no new fitting or hyperparameter search.
preserve_original: Do not modify results/cantarell/selection.json or replace its primary winner.
paired_ablation: Keep the selected gamma0-trained filtered model, scaler, filter and threshold fixed; replace gamma0 with sigma0 on the same eligible test samples.
freeze: Commit this amendment, execution code, the additional selection and its model before any test scoring.
disclosure: Report the validation tradeoff against the original primary; this late validation-stage amendment is requirement-driven and is not a claim of fully prospective model selection. Never retune using test results.
